pridane.name: test_tasks_request_unique
pridane.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX test_tasks_request_unique ON public.tasks USING btree (workspace_id, created_by_user_id, create_request_id)

pridane.name: test_tasks_single_probe
pridane.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX test_tasks_single_probe ON public.tasks USING btree ((true)) WHERE (create_request_id IS NOT NULL)

test_tasks_guard
